card.name: Partway through rare names and words
card.fires_on: Word pieces in the middle of rare proper names or long Latin-style words, such as Firmin, Omnivore, germinal, Taormina and Domenec. It fires on the piece just before the word ends.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly unrelated Chinese characters and odd pieces, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of unusual names and long Latin-sounding words, before the word is finished.
